description: PMH-3040 Plus is a pre-applied high density polyethylene (HDPE) waterproofing membrane. It is comprised of HDPE sheet, pressure sensitive adhesive and weather resistant protective coating. It is designed with 80mm dual adhesive seams that allows a strong bond which creates a super strong adhesion and is unaffected by weather. This integral bond is specifically designed to provide a robust barrier to water, moisture and gas and prevents both the ingress and lateral migration of water.
whereToUse: areas in contact with earth such as slabs & walls
caverns, tunnels, subways, municipal pipe corridors
advantages: Can be applied to permanent formwork, allows maximum use of confined sites
High puncture resistance, trafficable immediately after application
Easy roll/kick out installation reduces installation time and cost
Installed membrane is unaffected by freeze/thaw or wet/dry cycling
Chemical resistance, designed to help protect the structure from salt or sulphate attack, and is effective in most types of soils and waters
Resistant to methane and radon gases
notFor: Do not lay membrane in temperature below 5℃
Substrates must be regular and relatively even with no gaps or voids exceeding 12mm
Where temperatures will exceed 38°C (100° F) for more than a total of 7 days, concrete should be placed within 42 days of installation of the membrane
A sharp object is strictly forbidden to be used to consolidate the concrete during concrete pour
It is recommended that concrete be poured within 42 days after application of the membrane

technicalData.label: Water vapor transmission, g/(m2.h) (ASTM E96 Method B)

mixing: The surface does not need to be dry, but standing water must be removed.
